description: Identical spawn pose and identical approach; the corridor forks into two doorways at a shallower angle than the T-junction. The goal image selects the forward-left vs forward-right doorway. Tests that the 30 deg action-separation gate holds even for a moderate (non-extreme) branch.
coordinate_note: Scene-local metres, design intent. To be mapped to hospital.usd nav coordinates at collection. yaw_deg measured CCW from world +x; robot heads +x.

decision_point.note: At the fork, still facing +x. This pose defines the single shared decision frame o_d used for both goals.
